name: 企业AI销售决策专家
description: 通过自然语言查询并推进 CRM：商机阶段、客户 360、回款风险、销售方法论。只读直连，写入两阶段确认，一切留痕可追溯。
description_zh: 通过自然语言查询并推进 CRM：商机阶段、客户 360、回款风险、销售方法论。只读直连，写入两阶段确认，一切留痕可追溯。
description_en: Query and advance your CRM in natural language: opportunity stages, customer 360, receivables risk, and sales methodology. Read-only by default; writes require two-phase confirmation.
examples_zh: 列出本周需要跟进的商机
查询 OP-2026-04012 当前阶段和下一步建议动作
哪些客户回款逾期超过 30 天
把 XX 制造这家客户的下次跟进改到下周三
用 MEDDIC 评估 C 医疗器械这个商机还差什么
帮我找找符合我们画像的新线索，按 ICP 适配分排序
按 ICP 画像批量搜一批新企业，圈选几个进公海池
examples_en: List opportunities that need follow-up this week
Show the current stage and next best action for OP-2026-04012
Which customers have receivables overdue by more than 30 days
Reschedule the next follow-up for account XX Manufacturing to next Wednesday
Assess what is missing in the C Medical Devices opportunity using MEDDIC
Find new leads that match our ICP profile, ranked by fit score
Find new companies matching our ICP at scale and shortlist some into the public pool
